hook: Your Maldives holiday is on the lowest country on Earth.
title: The Maldives Is Barely Above the Sea
description:
The Maldives is the lowest-lying country on Earth. Its highest natural point is often listed at only about 2.4 metres above sea level. Most of the islands sit just above the waves.

#Shorts #Maldives #Geography
